title: AI is already in the music you love (derived carousel, carries Wed 11 Nov under.the.hood, piece 36886e0b)

five_whys.q: Why is Movin' To The Sun both AI and human?
five_whys.a: An AI app sang a Reiki healer's lyrics first, then a DJ rebuilt it and a dance star sang over a trace of the AI voice.

five_whys.q: Why did an AI app start it?
five_whys.a: She had lyrics but no studio or training, and an app like Suno turns typed lyrics into a sung demo.

five_whys.q: Why did a demo become a UK number two?
five_whys.a: Strangers heard it under other people's short videos, went hunting for it, and professionals finished it.

five_whys.q: Why is this bigger than one song?
five_whys.a: Deezer says AI-made tracks passed half of new uploads a day while getting 1 to 3% of listening: making is cheap, being found is scarce.

five_whys.q: Why should an everyday business person care?
five_whys.a: Work landing on their desk is made the same way, so 'did AI make this?' tells them nothing; ask who did which bit and make it part of sign-off.

cards.headline: A UK chart hit began in an AI app
cards.line: Movin' To The Sun reached number two. AI music apps like Suno turn typed lyrics into a sung song.
cards.picture: Cover scene: a record cut open like a cake, its layers showing, a phone with a music app at the bottom layer

cards.headline: A DJ and a singer finished it.
cards.line: HUGEL rebuilt the track. Ultra Naté sang it, with a trace of the AI voice underneath.
cards.picture: Four stacked layers: her words, the AI app's first song, the DJ's rebuild, the singer's voice

cards.headline: An AI app gave a healer her demo.
cards.line: Bernadett Gango, a Reiki healer with lyrics but no studio, wrote it. The app sang it first.
cards.picture: A closed studio door marked STUDIO, a demo slipping underneath it

cards.headline: Over half of new uploads are AI.
cards.line: At Deezer, every day. Yet they get only 1 to 3% of listening. Being found is hard.
cards.picture: Two bars to scale: AI share of new uploads 50%+, AI share of listening 1 to 3%
cards.source: Deezer, July 2026 (AI tracks passed 50% of daily new uploads) and April 2026 (1 to 3% of streams)

cards.headline: Work at your office is part AI too.
cards.line: A person's idea, an AI draft, people finishing it. The advert, the deck, the report.
cards.picture: A slide deck in three layers: idea, AI draft, human finish

cards.headline: Ask who did which bit.
cards.line: Of any work that lands on your desk: whose idea, what a tool drafted, who checked it.
cards.picture: Three labelled rows: IDEA, DRAFTED BY, CHECKED AND SIGNED BY

cards.headline: Put that on every work sign-off.
cards.line: The approval line on a brief or report, so its name is whoever stands behind it. Follow for more.
cards.picture: A sign-off form with the three lines filled, Follow for more over the centred wordmark

read_back.reader: Fresh reader A (Haiku, a small-business owner, headlines only, once; round 2)

answers.what: AI is now behind much of the music being made and much of the work done in offices.
answers.happened: A UK chart hit started in an AI app, and a human DJ and singer finished it.
answers.why: AI makes starting things cheap, so people need to know who did what.
answers.so_what: I need to know which work is genuinely ours and whether staff and suppliers use AI honestly.
answers.do: Ask my team who did which part of each job and record it on every work sign-off.

read_back.reader: Fresh reader B (Sonnet, a 15-year-old, headlines only, once; round 2)

answers.what: A song that hit the UK charts started in an AI app, and real people finished it.
answers.happened: A DJ and a singer took the AI-made track and polished it into the finished hit.
answers.why: AI makes so much stuff that over half of new uploads are AI, and it is in normal jobs too.
answers.so_what: What I scroll and what adults work on might be part AI without anyone saying so.
answers.do: Ask who did which part of anything I see or make, and say what was AI and what was me.

sources: Official Charts, Movin' To The Sun (HUGEL, Imael Angel, Ultra Naté), peak 2 (via the piece)
We Rave You on HUGEL's production list (via the piece)

read_back_fixed: Round 1 stumbled on 'made this way' (what way), 'number two' (which chart) and 'sign-off' (what is that); cards 1, 5 and 7 now say chart hit, part AI, and the line defines sign-off. Round 2 stumbled on 'its writer' (AI or human?); card 3 now says an AI app gave a healer her first demo, and card 6's line says whose work to ask about.
